## Why This Is Asked

Tests ability to design scalable, isolation-focused pipelines across AWS accounts, with per-tenant config, controlled traffic shifts, and automated rollback. It also checks cross-account IAM, IaC discipline, and integration of synthetic monitoring into deployments.

## Key Concepts

- Multi-account isolation for tenants
- GitHub Actions-driven CI/CD and IaC (CDK/CloudFormation)
- AppConfig per-tenant feature flags
- ALB weighted target groups for blue/green deployments
- CloudWatch Synthetics for synthetic monitoring and SLIs-based rollback
- Cross-account IAM roles and permissions
- Rollback criteria and post-deploy checks

## Code Example

```yaml
# Example GitHub Actions workflow snippet
name: tenant-deploy
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        tenant: [prod, acct-101, acct-202]
    steps:
      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v1
        with:
          role-duration-seconds: 3600
      - name: Deploy tenant via CDK/CFN
        run: |
          npm install
          npm run cdk:deploy -- --tenant ${{ matrix.tenant }}
```

- How would you handle tenant onboarding/offboarding while preserving compliance?
- What would be your strategy to prune unused AppConfig configurations across tenants?

## Why This Is Asked
Tests understanding of secure, auditable deployments and basic rollback mechanics in CodePipeline.

## Key Concepts
- Least-privilege IAM for Lambda execution role and CodePipeline
- API Gateway permissions and resource policies
- CloudWatch alarms and automatic rollback in CI/CD
- Versioning and rollback of Lambda functions

## Code Example
```yaml
Resources:
  LambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: { Service: "lambda.amazonaws.com" }
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaLoggingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "arn:aws:logs:*:*:*"
        - PolicyName: S3AccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:GetObject
                Resource: "arn:aws:s3:::deployment-bucket/*"

  LambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaRole.Arn
      # ... other function properties

  ErrorAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: LambdaErrorAlarm
      AlarmDescription: "Triggers rollback on 5xx errors"
      MetricName: 5XXError
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 5
      Threshold: 10
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref RollbackAction

  RollbackAction:
```
